title: Offer Price of an Expired Commercial Natural Gas Supply Term by Notice Timing
content:
**Rule.** After a Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement has rolled over, the offer price the renewed price starts from follows how the two expiration notices of the expired term were given. Each notice's timing is counted in calendar days from its notice date to the contract end date it refers to.

- When the final options notice was dated fewer than 30 calendar days before the contract end date it refers to, and the initial renewal notice was dated within its window, no earlier than 90 and no later than 60 calendar days before that date, the offer price is the initial notice's new rate per therm.
- When the final options notice was dated fewer than 30 days before that date and the initial notice was outside its window, the offer price is the lower of the two notices' new rates per therm.
- In every other case the final options notice's new rate per therm is the offer price.

## Truth table

| Final options notice dated fewer than 30 days before the end date | Initial renewal notice dated 60 to 90 days before the end date | Offer price |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The initial notice's new rate |
| Yes | No | The lower of the two new rates |
| No | Yes | The final options notice's new rate |
| No | No | The final options notice's new rate |

## Worked cases (hypothetical contract end date 2025-12-31; initial notice $0.5800, final options notice $0.6100)

| Initial notice dated | Final options notice dated | Offer price |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-10-15 (77 days before) | 2025-12-10 (21 days before) | $0.5800, the initial notice's rate |
| 2025-11-20 (41 days before) | 2025-12-10 (21 days before) | $0.5800, the lower of the two |
| 2025-10-15 (77 days before) | 2025-12-01 (30 days before) | $0.6100, the final options notice's rate |
| 2025-10-02 (90 days before) | 2025-12-02 (29 days before) | $0.5800, the initial notice's rate |

Had the final options notice in the second row offered $0.5650 instead, the lower rate, $0.5650, would be the offer price.
